scope.rationale: 2 new files only: application-dev.yml (profile config) + R__dev_sample_data.sql (repeatable migration). 1 minor edit to backend/README.md. No changes to existing Java code, existing migrations, or other profiles.

integration.rationale: Zero external API integrations. All data is local to the embedded Postgres instance. No network calls, no external services.

infrastructure.rationale: Reuses existing Zonky embedded Postgres infrastructure from the local profile. No new dependencies in build.gradle.kts. No Docker, no container changes, no CI pipeline changes.

knowledge.rationale: Requires understanding of all entity relationships (15 tables), FK constraints ordering, partition boundaries, JSONB contract shapes (HttpConfiguration, TcpConfiguration), and Flyway repeatable migration semantics. All well-documented in existing artifacts.

risk.rationale: Dev-only feature. Zero production blast radius. Zonky database is ephemeral. Worst case: seed SQL has a bug and dev profile fails to start — local and test profiles unaffected.

pipeline_phases_note: SIMPLE classification skips Research (Phase 3) and Assessment (Phase 2). However, all 6 phases are included for thoroughness given the breadth of entity coverage.

risk_register.description: Hardcoded partition names (execution_results_2026_04) will stop working after May 2026
risk_register.impact: LOW (dev profile only — seed SQL fails, error is obvious)
risk_register.mitigation: Use CURRENT_DATE arithmetic in SQL to dynamically compute partition-safe timestamps. Partition bootstrap on app startup ensures the target months exist.

risk_register.description: Schema drift: future V* migrations add required columns not covered by seed SQL
risk_register.impact: LOW (Flyway checksum unchanged → R__ doesn't re-run → but missing columns have defaults or are nullable. If NOT NULL without default → seed SQL fails visibly on next dev profile startup)
risk_register.mitigation: Repeatable migration (R__) re-runs on checksum change. When adding new V* migrations with NOT NULL columns, update R__dev_sample_data.sql in the same PR.
